description: This file is a header (.h) file for the curl project, defining function prototypes and including macros related to the 'tool_operhlp' module, which appears to handle operational helper functions such as URL and file handling.

methods.name: clean_getout
methods.description: Clears or resets output-related settings in the provided operation configuration structure.

methods.name: output_expected
methods.description: Checks whether output is expected for a given URL and upload file.

methods.name: stdin_upload
methods.description: Handles uploading data from standard input for the specified upload file.

methods.name: add_file_name_to_url
methods.description: Appends a filename to the provided URL within a CURL handle context.

methods.name: get_url_file_name
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a URL and returns it.

methods.name: urlerr_cvt
methods.description: Converts curl URL error codes to internal representations.
